title: 技術者のための数理Ⅱ（再履修クラス）
subtitle: Mathematics and Science for Engineer II
courseType: Mathematics and Science ProgramMathematics and Science Courses
educationalGoal:
Students will learn:
(1) differential coefficients.
(2) derivatives of various functions.
(3) fundamental theorem of calculus.
(4) definite and indefinite integrals.
advice:
This is a basic course in mathematics and science for engineer. We will cover the following topics:

1. Differential coefficients.
2. Derivatives of various functions.
3. Fundamental theorem of calculus.
4. Integrals of various functions.

Extra classes may be held depending the comprehension level of students.
Students are required to review and preview each class. As a matter of particular emphasis, students are required to attempt the exercises after each class.
Extra materials may be distributed if necessary.
Students are required to show their procedure for solution/calculation logically and clearly in each assignment.
Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the instructor.

activityGoals.body: Understand the theory of differentiation and find the equation of tangent lines.
Find the derivatives of basic functions.
Understand the concept of the fundamental theorem of calculus.
Evaluate the indefinite integrals of various functions.
Understand the meanings of fundamental English words for mathematics.
Be able to demonstrate an understanding of all topics, attend every class, and do the required works.
